decisions.reason: Moving the adjacent room wall and Unit 3 bathroom fixtures does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The corridor adjustment does not change retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
The referenced room-wall shift is for narrowing the corridor and does not entail any change to the balcony disposition.
The existing message-48 MODIFY already fully records the required relocation of the Unit 3 drain and shower to the left wall; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Message 48 does not change the kitchen counter arrangement or its bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The corridor and Unit 3 bathroom adjustment does not alter Unit 1's 2+1 room program.
The specific 10 cm wall shift does not cancel or modify the general policy of preserving existing walls where possible or the recorded actions for marked walls.
The requested layout adjustment does not change the required count of three dwellings.
The source explicitly concerns the Unit 3 bathroom and does not change the Unit 1 common bathroom layout.
The wall and fixture relocations do not entail a change to the open-plan kitchen configuration or cabinet quantities and dimensions.
Changing a wall position does not modify the independent requirement that room dimensions be annotated on the plan.
